title: acuSimNet: Multi-View Self-Occlusion-Awared Visibility Learning for Cranio-Cervical Acupuncture Points
abstract: arXiv:2611.20025v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The localization of acupuncture points (acupoints) in Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) presents unique challenges since they are defined by abstract principles rather than distinct anatomical landmarks. Existing approaches are typically constrained to single view or rely on indirect calculations of relative positions with respect to other landmarks, thereby overlooking human anatomical variations. Furthermore, acupoint visibility assessment, which determins whether points are occluded by human itself, hair, clothing, or other objects, has received limited attention in practical applications. Acupoint localization itself does not require 3D reconstruction, but inferring their occlusion relationships with anatomical surfaces does, which adds computational cost and limits real-time inference. translated_title: acuSimNet：面向颅颈针灸穴位的多视角自遮挡感知可见性学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.20025v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：中医（TCM）中针灸穴位的定位面临着独特的挑战，因为穴位的定义基于抽象的原则而非明确的解剖学标志。现有方法通常局限于单视角，或依赖于相对于其他标志点的间接位置计算，从而忽略了人体解剖结构的个体差异。此外，穴位可见性评估——即判断穴位是否被人体自身、头发、衣物或其他物体遮挡——在实际应用中受到的关注十分有限。穴位定位本身并不需要三维重建，但推断其与解剖表面的遮挡关系却需要三维重建，这增加了计算成本并限制了实时推理能力。在这项工作中，我们提出了acuSimNet，这是一种高效的多任务分层学习架构，用于多视角、自遮挡感知的可见性预测。
tldr: 本文提出acuSimNet，一种高效的多任务分层学习架构，实现了颅颈针灸穴位的多视角自遮挡感知可见性预测，克服了传统方法局限于单视角、忽略解剖个体差异且缺乏遮挡评估的不足。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes acuSimNet, an efficient hierarchical multi-task learning architecture enabling multi-view, self-occlusion-aware visibility prediction for cranio-cervical acupuncture points, overcoming the limitations of single-view approaches, anatomical variations, and neglected visibility assessment.
